problems:
# Lithuania — notes

- Source: Official Statistics Portal (osp.stat.gov.lt) REST SDMX data service, indicator S3R815 "Užregistruotų nusikaltimų, baudžiamųjų nusižengimų skaičius" (data owner: Informatikos ir ryšių departamentas, Ministry of the Interior) with structure M3170102 = offence type × municipality × year. Offence code A11 "Nužudymai / Homicides" extracted for all 74 areas (Republic, 2 NUTS-2 regions "Sostinės regionas"/"Vidurio ir vakarų Lietuvos regionas", 10 apskritys, 60 savivaldybės), years 1993–2023. Also kept A0 (all criminal offences) and A1 (crimes) for context, plus the per-100,000 variant S3R816.
- Municipality rows have blank parent (county membership not in the codelist); counties' parent is the Republic.
- OBS_STATUS flags are copied into the note column ("category not applicable" = phenomenon did not occur; "indicator is not calculated in such expression"). A blank value with such a note is as published.
- 2024/2025 not yet in this dataset (DS_LAST_UPDATE for S3R539 was 2024-07-18; S3R815 last year 2023). IRD's own site (ird.lt) was not reached: searching stopped early (search limit reached); not opened.
- Licence: could not open the OSP copyright/terms page (403 JavaScript challenge by direct download; the web reader error). Licence left as "not verified".
- Statistics Lithuania also has an older yearbook series SSST902R004 "Crimes registered in cities and districts" (1991 data) not extracted.
